# Approved findings (generated file; do not edit by hand)

Generated by `python3 -I scripts/generate_approved_findings.py` from `data/processed/`. It states what may be shown publicly, with the rule used to classify each item. Full tables are in `docs/RESULTS.md`; method rules in `docs/SCIENTIFIC_METHODS.md`. Every number below is computed from the data files. All results are **exploratory**: nothing was preregistered, and no reviewer sign-off on the methods is recorded in this repository.

Classification rule: a trend is **supported** only if its Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 in its declared family; otherwise **inconclusive** (not evidence of no change).

## 0. Data coverage (mutually exclusive road-record statuses)

`road_operations.csv` has 544 rows = 17 routes x 32 winters (1993/94 to 2024/25). Each row has exactly one status:

| Status | Rows |
|---|---|
| flagged_inconsistent | 4 |
| missing_not_available | 24 |
| not_applicable_note | 4 |
| verified | 512 |
| **Total** | **544** |

Only `verified` rows carry dates and enter any trend. The categories sum exactly to the row total and to routes x winters. (An earlier report quoted 540 rows; that figure was wrong. The data have always held 544.)

## A. Valid environmental observations (reanalysis, with required caveat)

- NASA POWER daily T2M for two points, 2001-10-01 to 2025-06-30; 24 winters (2001/02 to 2024/25) with 0 missing days in the trend seasons.
- Against the Yellowknife A station (8574 paired days) NASA is -5.50 C in Oct-Dec and -3.57 C in Jan-Mar. NASA mean Oct-Dec FDD is 1551 versus 1059 C-days at the station (+46.5%) on 17 winters, with year-to-year correlation r = 0.92.
- Required wording on every temperature figure: "NASA POWER T2M is MERRA-2 reanalysis for a 0.5 x 0.625 degree cell. At the Yellowknife cell it is on average 3.4 to 7.3 C colder than the airport station in Oct-Dec (2001-2025)."
- Use NASA series for year-to-year variation and trends with intervals. Do not present absolute NASA temperatures, FDD or thaw-day counts as local conditions.

## B. Supported trends (q < 0.05 in the stated family)

- Aklavik open day, 1993-2024: -6.7 days per decade, q = 0.048 (all-routes family of 51). Fragile: absent in 2001-2024 (section C). Road identity and segment unverified (`ROUTE_IDENTITY.md`); not a replication of Dettah. Exploratory.
- Aklavik open to close days, 1993-2024: +8.3 days per decade, q = 0.020 (all-routes family of 51). Road identity and segment unverified (`ROUTE_IDENTITY.md`); not a replication of Dettah. Exploratory.
- Dettah opening day (full record, n = 32): +9.0 days per decade, 95% CI +3.6 to +12.4, block CI +5.2 to +12.6, p <0.001. Positive means later opening.
- Dettah open-to-close interval (full record): -10.2 days per decade, 95% CI -15.8 to -5.3, q = 0.004. The interval is not usable days.
- Of 51 route-level tests across NWT routes, 28 have p < 0.05 and 26 have q < 0.05 (Holm: 10); signs are mixed across routes (`RESULTS.md` section 4).
- Caveat to show: the Dettah series is selection-biased (the route was chosen after its trend was seen); the 51-test family is the adjustment.

## C. Inconclusive or fragile trends

- Dettah opening day, 2001-2024 (n = 24): +10.3 days per decade, CI +3.3 to +17.2, q = 0.085 in the 126-test family (not below 0.05). Dropping the first five winters: +9.1, Theil-Sen CI +0.0 to +19.0, p 0.073. Sensitive to the early years.
- Aklavik opening day: -6.7 days per decade over 1993-2024 (q = 0.048) but -0.5 over 2001-2024 (CI -10.8 to +3.8). Not robust.
- NASA Oct-Dec FDD: Dettah +15 C-days per decade (CI -108 to +111, q = 0.899); Aklavik -74 (CI -150 to +6, q = 0.354). Not distinguishable from no change in 24 winters; this is not proof of no change.
- Across all 126 extended NASA-window trend tests, 20 have p < 0.05 (about 6.3 expected by chance); 0 have q < 0.05; no climate metric survives correction (0 of the climate family).
- Jan-Mar thaw days: not estimated. Dettah had thaw in 1 of 24 winters (total thaw days: 1), Aklavik in 0 of 24. Reanalysis runs cold, so zero NASA thaw days does not mean no thaw.

## D. Exploratory operational associations (not mechanisms)

- Yellowknife A snow-on-ground on Nov 28 versus Dettah opening day: Spearman rho +0.64 (CI 0.39 to 0.85), n = 23, q = 0.005 in a 5-predictor family. The snow series itself has a trend of +4.0 cm per decade (CI -1.7 to +8.7), so it does not show that snow changed and does not explain the opening trend. Label: hypothesis.
- Leak-free NASA climate predictors versus Dettah and Aklavik opening/closing dates: all confidence intervals include zero = True.
- Windows that overlapped the outcome were removed: the Oct-Dec window reached the Dettah opening date in 16 of 24 winters.

## E. Statistical limitations to show

- 24 winters for NASA-window trends; 15 is the minimum for any estimate. Theil-Sen with Mann-Kendall p and a moving-block bootstrap CI; residual lag-1 > 0.3 is flagged.
- Five declared hypothesis families (F1_all_extended: 126, F2_climate: 99, F3_road_2001_2024: 27, F4_road_record_all_routes: 51, F5_road_climate_associations: 11); tests are not independent, so q values are indicative.
- NASA values are reanalysis for a 0.5 x 0.625 degree cell; one cell is not the whole road; Dettah (about 6.5 km lake crossing) and Aklavik (delta road, length ambiguous) are different objects; the road record is operations, not ice measurement.
- No bias correction is applied anywhere. No causal inference is made. Statistical sign-off is pending (owner: Yao); none is recorded here.

## F. Prohibited claims

- Any prediction of opening dates, ice thickness, usable days or road safety; any statement that a road is or will be safe or unsafe.
- Any statement that warming, snow, or any other variable caused, drove or explains the Dettah or Aklavik date trends.
- Any pooled significance test across corridors or winters; any unadjusted p-value presented as a finding without its family and q.
- Presenting NASA absolute temperatures, FDD or thaw counts as local observations, or applying the 380 C-day threshold to this data.
- Any synthetic value (`UI/data/`, `UI/generate_data.py`) shown as real; any fallback to synthetic figures.
- Claiming Giovanni/MERRA-2 extraction, NASA eligibility confirmation, community adoption, stakeholder endorsement or statistician sign-off that has not happened.
